title: Presentation Script Writer — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Creates speaking notes and full scripts for presentations. The Presentation Script Writer creates speaking notes for presentations. It takes the slide outline and turns it into natural spoken language: an opening hook, talking points per slide, transitions, and a closing call to action. It estimates timing per section so the talk fits the slot, and marks where to pause, emphasize, or advance the slide.
capabilities: Turn slide outlines into natural spoken scripts
Write openings, transitions, and closings
Estimate timing per section
Mark pauses, emphasis, and slide advances
Produce short cue notes or full scripts
